function.description: What changed since the user last looked.
function.name: digest

function.description:
Find people who know about a subject. When the subject is one person (a name, an alias,
or a description that fits one person on the roster) only that person is offered. The
user is shown a way to talk to them; you cannot move the user yourself.
function.name: find_people

topic.description: The subject, in plain words. The one the user picks is told it as the reason.

function.description: Ask a person to look into a question for the user.
function.name: ask

question.description: The question, as the user would put it.

turns.description: Turn budget. Leave out to use the default.

function.description:
Start a group conversation among two or more people. One person is never a group: the
user is then only shown a way to talk to them. The result gives the group id when one
was made, and the user is shown a way to open it; you cannot move the user yourself.
function.name: create_group

purpose.description:
Why the group exists, in one short line (about sixty characters), for example
"plan a birthday party". Every member is told. Leave out for casual talk.

function.description: Change whether a person or a group may speak unprompted. Only when the user asks.
function.name: set_mode

mode.description: Whether a person or a group may act without being addressed.

oneOf.description: May speak unprompted (with a seed, within the daily limits).
Never speaks first; still answers when triggered. Everyone starts here.
Cannot be triggered and never appears in any option offered to a model.

function.description: Search the whole archive. Sees every passage and no memories.
function.name: search

persons.description: Only passages about these people (roster ids).

query.description: What to look for, in plain words.

function.description: Write down one thing for the user. Only when the user asks.
function.name: remember

text.description: The thing to remember, as one short sentence.

function.description: Delete one remembered thing for the user. Only when the user asks. Can be restored.
function.name: forget

fact_id.description: The id of the remembered thing.

function.description:
List the user's conversations, most recent first. The user is shown a way to open each;
you cannot move the user yourself.
function.name: list_channels

function.description: Search the archive for passages about something.
function.name: search

persons.description: Only passages about these people (roster ids).

query.description: What to look for, in plain words.

function.description: Read one passage in full, optionally with its neighbours.
function.name: get_chunk

id.description: The passage id, as shown in `[#id]`.

neighbours.description: How many adjacent passages to include on each side.

function.description:
Ask a colleague to join this conversation, when the matter is clearly outside what you
know or can do; anything you can answer yourself, you answer. Give a person, or a topic
to find one by.
function.name: request_join

topic.description: What they should know about, when you do not know who.

turns.description: Turns to hand over from your own, while looking into a request. Default 1.

function.description: Remember one thing from this conversation.
function.name: remember

text.description: The thing to remember, as one short sentence.

function.description: Answer the request you were asked to look into. Ends the request.
function.name: report

cites.description: Ids of the passages the reply rests on.

note.description: A longer written note to leave with the reply, in Markdown.

text.description: Your reply, as you would say it.

function.description: Close the conversation: what to remember from it.
function.name: wrapup

facts.description: Concrete things that happened or were promised. May be empty.

due.description: For a commitment: when it is due, ISO 8601 date or date-time.

oneOf.description: A preference, or a specific thing that happened.
Something someone promised to do, with a time.

hurt.description: Only for clear cruelty, insult, humiliation or betrayal aimed at a person.

person.description: Roster id of the person it was aimed at; needed only in a group.

summary.description: A summary of the conversation so far, when asked for one.

function.description:
Ask the host to arrange something for the user: someone who knows a subject, or a group
with some colleagues. You help the user yourself first; this is for matters clearly
outside what you know or can do, or when the user asks for someone or a group. The user
is only shown the suggestion and decides; nothing happens before. Give exactly one of
`find` and `group`, at most once per reply.
function.name: ask_host

find.description:
A subject, in plain words, for the host to find colleagues who know it. The one
found is told it as the reason.

group.description: Roster ids of colleagues for the host to propose a group with; you are included.

purpose.description:
With `group`: why the group is worth making, in one short line (about sixty
characters), for example "plan a birthday party". The members are told.
